extracted.intended_audience: agency legislative liaison offices / agency legislative staff
extracted.subtask_short: final copy submissions under OMB A-19
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for executive-branch agencies to submit ‘‘final’’ copies of cleared legislative materials to OMB/LRD and to notify OMB of transmission delays or testimony cancellations/rescheduling under OMB Circular No. A-19.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of items to be submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: "all proposed legislation, transmittal letters and accompanying materials, and reports (including testimony)"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memorandum requests that agencies provide OMB/LRD copies of these specific categories of materials that have received OMB clearance. The list defines which materials are covered by the submission requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of copies required
rubrics_metrics.description: "provide OMB/LRD two copies of all proposed legislation, transmittal letters and accompanying materials, and reports (including testimony)"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must send two physical (or otherwise specified) copies to OMB/LRD for each covered item. The memorandum explicitly specifies 'two copies' as the required quantity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide materials in the form actually transmitted
rubrics_metrics.description: "in the form actually transmitted to Congress."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The materials supplied to OMB/LRD should be the final version in the exact form that the agency transmits to Congress (not drafts or annotated versions). This ensures OMB's legislative files reflect what was publicly transmitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate notification if cleared items will not be transmitted promptly
rubrics_metrics.description: "notify OMB immediately if reports or proposed legislation that have received OMB clearance will not be transmitted promptly to Congress"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must promptly inform OMB/LRD whenever a cleared report or proposed piece of legislation will be delayed or withheld from prompt transmission to Congress. The timing requirement is 'immediately.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of cancelled or rescheduled cleared testimony
rubrics_metrics.description: "notify OMB immediately ... if cleared testimony has been cancelled or rescheduled."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If testimony that previously received OMB clearance is later cancelled or its schedule changed, the agency must notify OMB/LRD immediately so OMB's records remain current.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal/administrative authority for the request
rubrics_metrics.description: "This request is made pursuant to OMB Circular No. A-19 (sections 8c.(4) and 8c.(6))."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memorandum cites specific sections of OMB Circular A-19 as the basis for requiring submission and notification; agencies should follow the cited provisions when implementing these requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: ensure OMB legislative files accurately reflect Administration position
rubrics_metrics.description: "Your assistance will help to ensure that our legislative files reflect accurately the Administration's public position on legislation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing final copies and timely notifications serves the stated objective of keeping OMB's legislative records accurate with respect to the Administration's public positions; this is the motivating rationale for the procedural requirements.
